description: Read OUTCOME FORECAST RESEARCH. With no arguments, the questions the house has published, newest first, each with its status and its text. With questionId, one question in full: its text, the board data it is answered from and when that data is read, its range or threshold, the hash a forecast names, how many forecasts it holds and, once answered, its answer and an aggregate score. view notice: the research notice every question carries, with its version and hash. Only counts and aggregate scores are shown: never a wallet, never a forecast. It is research, never a market. The program is held off until the operator switches the NET programs on together, and until then the read says so plainly; this tool moves no NET, and the house pays, holds and sells nothing through it. Free, keyless, nothing to sign. Cost and signer: free and keyless, nothing to sign.
